column1: # Old Testament words the New Testament applies to Christ take the Son color: the Prophets.
# Rule as in 40_: only the words the NT applies to him, and pronouns for him in a passage the source already colors as his; titles of God keep the Father color.
# Columns: ref <TAB> term <TAB> occurrence <TAB> from <TAB> to <TAB> note (with the NT reference)

they shall call his name Emmanuel (Matt 1:23)
I will put my trust in him, said by Christ (Heb 2:13)
Behold I and the children which God hath given me (Heb 2:13)
the child, the son given: "upon his shoulder", "his name shall be called Wonderful" (the names already in the Son's color)
his government, "his kingdom" upon the throne of David (Luke 1:32-33); "the LORD of hosts" stays
the Branch of 11:1, already the Son's color
the Branch (2 Thess 2:8, "the breath of his lips")

the servant, "in whom my soul is well pleased" (Matt 12:18)
in his name shall the Gentiles trust (Matt 12:21)
the Servant of 52:13-53:12, preached as Jesus (Acts 8:32-35)
the Servant (John 12:38; Acts 8:35); "before him" is the LORD and stays
a man of sorrows, the Servant himself
by whose stripes ye were healed (1 Pet 2:24)
he was led as a sheep to the slaughter (Acts 8:32)
who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth (1 Pet 2:22)

the Servant; "I" is the LORD and stays

I will smite the shepherd (Matt 26:31; Mark 14:27)
the man that is my fellow, the same shepherd
the Son of man brought near; "before him" is the Ancient of days and stays
